# What does tutoring really pay per hour? Your real rate after prep, travel, cancellations and fees

> Free calculator for private tutors: sessions, rate, prep, travel, cancellations, platform fees and admin time become your real hourly pay, yearly net, and the session rate that reaches your target. Private, runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
